quarterly_data.signal: Chief International Commercial Officer Alexandre de Germay: in the international division, new and reacquired products went from $0.5 billion in 2023 to $4 billion now, the top four countries make 40% of the business, China is the biggest country outside the U.S., and sales-force productivity tripled in three years after resources were reallocated to key markets and products; COVID revenue fell from $11 billion in 2024 to about $6.7 billion in 2025, with $4 billion guided for 2026; Pfizer has 31 Phase III clinical studies running. AI already lets study reports be produced a few days after the last patient's last visit instead of three months.
quarterly_data.figure: international new and reacquired products $4 billion, from $0.5 billion in 2023; 31 Phase III studies

quarterly_data.signal: Chief International Commercial Officer Alexandre de Germay: international LORBRENA sales were a quarter of a billion this quarter, already a $1 billion product, with 60%-70% of first-line new patient starts (77% in France) and 50% in China; after Prevnar 20 entered Brazil, 80% of its 2.5 million babies are vaccinated; older-adult pneumococcal / RSV vaccination reaches only 25% of the target population in France, 28% in Germany and 3% in Japan. Pfizer goes into thoracic cancer (a market projected at $70 billion by 2030) with three Phase III candidates: two ADCs and a VEGF / PD-L1 bispecific.
quarterly_data.figure: LORBRENA international a quarter of a billion this quarter; 77% first-line share in France

quarterly_data.signal: Chief International Commercial Officer Alexandre de Germay on obesity: Pfizer recently commercialized its first GLP-1, ecnoglutide, in China; Pfizer sees the market at $120 billion-$150 billion by 2030, split into many segments, with average out-of-pocket prices around EUR 300 to EUR 350 per month in most international markets, stable so far; for its Phase III GLP-1 program the weekly studies are already fully recruited and the monthly and switch studies have started, and the amylin / GLP-1 combination 'is going to be reading out at the end of this year'; Pfizer keeps looking for complementary assets, including in China.
quarterly_data.figure: obesity market $120 billion-$150 billion by 2030; EUR 300 to EUR 350 per month out-of-pocket
